login.headline: Back-office console for branch staff
login.intro: Onboarding, KYC review and service requests in one place. Authorised staff only.
login.logged: All activity in this session is logged.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your staff ID and password.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask an administrator to reset it.
login.locked: This account is locked after too many failed sign-ins. Ask an administrator to unlock it.
login.invalid_one: Staff ID or password is incorrect. 1 attempt left before the account is locked.
login.invalid_other: Staff ID or password is incorrect. {{count}} attempts left before the account is locked.
login.tooMany: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.signedOutIdle: You were signed out after a period of inactivity.
login.signedOutExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again.

change.title: Choose a new password
change.required: You signed in with a one-time password. Choose your own before you continue.
change.subtitle: Change the password you use to sign in.
change.rules: At least {{min}} characters. Common passwords and ones containing your staff ID or name aren't allowed.
